variants.parental_testing_statement: Maternal unaffected family members were Sanger sequenced; the two candidate variants (TNFAIP3, TNFRSF9) remained after this
variants.functional_evidence_statement: Each mutant A20 assessed by NFkB luciferase assay: over-expressed mutant protein failed to suppress TNF-induced NFkB activity in HEK293T cells (Fig. 2a) and Jurkat cells (Supplementary Fig. 3); co-transfection with WT A20 did not reverse WT suppression (no dominant-negative effect). Disease-associated A20 mutants showed a marked defect in deubiquitination of K63-ubiquitinated RIP1, NEMO and TRAF6 in transfected 293T cells (Fig. 3b-d). Wild-type A20 expression reduced and mutant protein not detectable in PBMCs from three Family 1 patients (Fig. 1d).
variants.pathogenicity_as_stated_by_authors: considered pathogenic (family segregation; absent from ExAC, dbSNP and in-house exome database)

phenotypic_features.severity_or_detail: stated for the whole study: 'none of our patients have developed lymphomas or other malignancies'
